claims.excerpt: Heat Stress Reached 84.4% of Global Reef Area During Fourth Bleaching Event
claims.claim: Bleaching-level heat stress affected roughly 84.4% of global reef area during the fourth global coral bleaching event.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: From January 1, 2023 through September 30, 2025, roughly 84.4% of global coral reef area experienced bleaching-level heat stress.
claims.narrative: satellite data show bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area from January 2023 through September 2025
claims.explanation: The title accurately summarizes the stated measurement and associates it with the fourth event; the narrative gives the measurement window.
claims.materiality: The event association is central, and the narrative clarifies the measured period.
